raster_policy.cell_group_rule: filename stem before first __, then remove trailing _X followed by digits
raster_policy.dedupe: exact supplied-tile target raster hashes deduplicated within each family; lexicographically first path retained; aliases preserved
raster_policy.geometry_units: EQUIV 1 1000 MICRON; integer GLP coordinates interpreted as nanometers
raster_policy.group_union: cell groups joined when exact target rasters tie, including ties across families
raster_policy.pixel_rule: scanline at pixel centers; vertical-edge crossings ymin<=y<ymax; fill intervals left<=x<right; PGON union
raster_policy.primary: fixed 1024x1024 at 4 nm; center bounding box using a translation rounded to 4 nm; no scale, crop, or clipping

excluded_fit_metadata.fit_hash_overlap_check: all independent 1024x1024 target hashes differ from cached FIT mask/target hashes

runtime_policy.fatal_input_or_runtime_failure: durable partial status; no scientific completion
runtime_policy.numerical_parity_mismatch: retain every scored layout, continue; validation and claim gates fail

bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive group-level interval; not validation of independent sampling

statistics.claim_gate: candidate-v-reference PVband 95% group-bootstrap CI upper bound < 0; mean nominal and worst-dose spatial mismatch-fraction deltas <= 0; no blank candidate layout; full raster, method, and hard-mask parity validation passed
statistics.primary_metric: equal mean over cell-group means of each layout's PVband pixels divided by target-positive pixels
